about.title: About
about.description: Emirhan Durmuşkaya: founder of Valmeto and Turing Robotics, rugby player and referee, writer.
about.lede: My time is split between a company, a robotics team and a rugby pitch, with writing on physics and philosophy in between.
about.entrepreneur: In 2026 I founded Valmeto İç ve Dış Ticaret, a B2B company supplying non-ferrous metals (copper, brass, bronze, aluminium), where I manage export operations and business development.
about.robotics: In 2025 I founded the FRC team Turing Robotics (#10141) at Halil Bekmezci Anadolu Lisesi and captained it; today I am its lead mentor. In its rookie season the team won the 2026 İstanbul Regional and qualified for the FIRST Championship in Houston. In 2027 we compete at the Bosphorus and Gotham Regionals, with grants from Boeing, 3M, RTX and Rockwell.
about.sports: I am a licensed rugby player: I went to the 2025 national team tryouts, played in the Men’s 1st League and the U18 1st League, and won the İstanbul school championship with my school in 2024 and 2025. In 2025–2026 I was a member of the Turkish Rugby Federation’s Central Referee Committee and a referee. Before rugby I held basketball and kickboxing licences.
about.writing: I research and write on science (especially physics), philosophy and history. My essays have been published as “ufens” on Evrim Ağacı, Academia and my own blogs; all of them are also listed here, in the Writing section.
about.education: I graduated from Halil Bekmezci Anadolu Lisesi in June 2025. Turkish is my native language; my English is B2.
